A member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|New Sith Order]], this '''[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]''' was part of [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|the strikeforce]] sent by [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] [[Morlish Veed]] to [[Operation: Thunderstroke|capture]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. The Zabrak [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fought]] against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]] but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the process.<ref name="Legacy 2006 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref> Following Sith tradition, this Zabrak wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
